name: OrchestraOS
_comment_mounts: The container has its OWN Claude login (a named volume, signed in once inside, kept across rebuilds). Never bind-mount or copy the host's ~/.claude: host and container would refresh one OAuth token and the loser is logged out (refresh-token rotation).
postAttachCommand: echo 'Log in to your agent CLI once (claude / codex login / agy), then: orchestra doctor && orchestra up'
